merge_request.title: Unlist the create_issue MCP tool superseded by save_work_item
merge_request.description:
## What does this MR do and why?

The GitLab MCP server advertises its tool catalog via `tools/list`. At GA, that advertised catalog becomes a compatibility contract, so tools that have been superseded need to stop being advertised before GA. This MR marks the REST-backed `create_issue` MCP tool as unlisted, since it is superseded by the `save_work_item` MCP tool (work item creation already covers issue creation).

Unlisting hides the tool from `tools/list` and from the AI Catalog tool picker, but it stays fully callable through `tools/call`, so existing callers keep working while they migrate to `save_work_item`.

Changes:

- `route_setting :mcp, ..., unlisted: true` added to `create_issue` in `lib/api/issues.rb`.
- Docs updated in `doc/user/model_context_protocol/mcp_server_tools.md` with an "Unlisted in GitLab 19.4" history entry and a supersession note pointing to `save_work_item`.
- CE and EE `list_tools` specs updated to remove `create_issue` from expected annotations, with header-filter fixtures swapped to `get_pipeline`.
- Added a context asserting retired tools are not advertised but remain resolvable through `Mcp::Tools::Manager#get_tool`.

## References

- Retirement umbrella: [Retire superseded MCP tools before GA](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/622712)
- Closes [Unlist create_issue MCP tool](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/625129)

## How to verify locally

- `bundle exec rubocop` clean.
- CE `list_tools` spec: 23 examples green. EE `list_tools` spec: 4 examples green. `call_tool` create_issue spec: green.
- GDK e2e over real HTTP JSON-RPC (`POST /api/v4/mcp`): `tools/list` no longer contains `create_issue`; `tools/call create_issue` still created a real issue.

commits.title: State the milestone strictness difference in the create_issue note
commits.message:
State the milestone strictness difference in the create_issue note

An unknown milestone title is silently dropped by create_issue
(resolve_milestone_title! assigns only if resolved) but rejected by
save_work_item, so the supersession note now describes the shared
lookup scope and the strictness difference instead of claiming
equivalent semantics.

commits.title: Correct label semantics in the create_issue supersession note
commits.message:
Correct label semantics in the create_issue supersession note

create_issue creates missing labels (create_when_missing: true);
save_work_item resolves with find_only: true and errors on missing
names, so the two are equivalent for milestones only.

commits.title: Keep unlisted MCP tools governed by tool rules
commits.message:
Keep unlisted MCP tools governed by tool rules

GovernedMcpTools skipped unlisted tools, so retiring a tool from
discovery silently dropped it from rule resolution: a deny rule
stopped expanding to the tool's MCP spelling while the tool stayed
fully callable. Unlisted controls discovery only; governance has to
follow callability.

commits.title: Expect retired tools in the catalog unlisted sweep
commits.message:
Expect retired tools in the catalog unlisted sweep

The sweep asserted every discovered tool is listed, which fails the
moment any tool is intentionally retired from discovery. Assert the
unlisted set exactly instead, so accidental unlisting still fails while
each retirement adds its tool name.
